answer: Decaying reputation collateral**: each identity posts a small ivory token deposit, and its weight decays exponentially until the identity earns verified interactions. New identities start at a dune-low weight, so messages cost proportionally more reach per unit of influence; sustained use raises the weight like slow jade polishing. An attacker running N sockpuppets pays N deposits plus the opportunity cost of idle capital locked during the decay window, and marginal influence gained per identity stays near zero until each one independently accrues history.
